_comment: Capability -> component sets, read by sgs-init.mjs (--with) and by the starting-an-app skill's interview. `core` is copied into every app unconditionally: it is the boot path (app-shell), the contracts (tokens, framework), and the pieces the shell imports on every start. Each capability lists EVERY component it needs, so resolving a capability is a set-union, never a graph walk. A component may appear under several capabilities (swatch, field-badge); the union dedupes. Removing a capability's WIRING from main.js and index.html is agent work the starting-an-app skill owns; this file only decides which files exist.

layer-panel.asks: A left panel with layer rows (visibility, swatch, zoom-to)?

table-dock.asks: A table across the bottom showing a layer's features?

popups.asks: Click-a-feature popups with leader lines and placement strategies?

tooltips.asks: Themed hover tooltips replacing the browser's title bubbles?

settings.asks: The gear popover: theme switch, popup placement, shortcut inventory?

about-window.asks: A large modal window shell (about box, welcome pane, report)?

dev-guides.asks: The red centre-line guides for icon work (dev-only CSS)?

demo-data.asks: Keep the two demo GeoJSON layers, or start with your own data?
